ASSEMBLY OF FRONT SEAT

PRECAUTION: Pay attention items below when assembling the front seat.

(a) To prevent warpage of the seat adjuster, carry out this operation on a level surface.

(b) Move the upper arm to the forward most position by turning the adjuster knob fully.

(c) Align the matchmarks of the seat adjuster inner by turning the hinge pin.
